z-m-03-01.title: Iphepha elide, elincinci neliphepha elifuthe: leliphi elikhulu ngendawo?
z-m-03-01.topic: Ukuthelekisa indawo (ukubeka elinye phezu kwelinye, nokuthelekisa neekwere ezinobungakanani obufanayo)
z-m-03-01.goal: Thelekisa indawo yamaphepha amabini abonakala eyahlukile ngemo ngokuwajonga ngamehlo, ngokubeka elinye phezu kwelinye, nangokuthelekisa neekwere zobukhulu obufanayo, ulungisa isigqibo sakho njengoko uqhubeka, uze uthi kufuneka enye indlela xa ukubeka elinye phezu kwelinye kungagqibi.
z-m-03-01.material: Kukho amaphepha amabini anoxande, '가' kunye '나', enziwe ngephepha eligingqiweyo. '가' yinxande ende ukusuka kwelinye icala ukuya kwelinye, kwaye '나' yinxande engade kangako kwaye impuphu kune-'가'. Ufuna ukufumanisa ukuba leliphi likhulu ngendawo (ubukhulu bomphezulu othathwa liphepha). Awukalinganisi ubude.
z-m-03-01.thinking.1: Ukutshintsha ukuqiniseka kwakho njengoko ulwazi olutsha lufika
z-m-03-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi 'ngaphezulu/ngaphantsi' nokuthelekisa izinto ezimbini ngokubeka enye phezu kwenye (inqanaba leBanga 1)
z-m-03-01.s.s1.prompt: Ulwazi luvezwa ngecandelo elinye ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha oko ukucingayo malunga nokuba leliphi likhulu ngendawo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, yitsho into enye malunga 'noko kufanayo noko kwahlukileyo' koko usanda kukufunda.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukusika amaphepha amabini ngokwenene ubeke elinye phezu kwelinye, uze ulandelele ngomnwe iindawo ezinwenwela ngaphandle.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Amaphepha amabini abekwe ngokwahlukeneyo etafileni kwaye ujonga ngamehlo kuphela. '가' ibonakala ende kwaye '나' ibonakala impuphu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucinga ukuba leliphi likhulu ngendawo ngoku?
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Kunzima ukugqiba ngokujonga nje ngeliso. Kufuneka indlela efana nokubeka elinye phezu kwelinye okanye ukuthelekisa neziqwenga zobukhulu obufanayo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 가 likhulu. Ububanzi bude, ngoko elide likhulu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ujonge ubude kwicala elinye kuphela. Kwindawo kufuneka ucinge ngobubanzi nokuphakama kunye.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Awunakwazi ngokujonga nje. Kufuneka ubeke elinye phezu kwelinye okanye ulinganise.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uqale wacinga ngendlela yokujonga. Yinto ilungileyo ukwahlula imvakalelo kuhlolo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 나 likhulu. Lipuphu, ngoko libonakala lizele ngakumbi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ugqibe ngemvakalelo. Inokuba ilungile, kodwa awunakwazi phambi kokuba uhlole.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Imilo yahlukile, ngoko iindawo zihlukile ngokuqinisekileyo. Asazi nje ukuba leliphi likhulu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Nokuba imilo yahlukile, iindawo zinokufana. Akukabikho sizathu sokuyithetha ngamandla ngolo hlobo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Ubeke '가' phezu kwe-'나' ngeekona ezingaphezulu ekhohlo zihambelana. '가' inwenwela ngaphandle kwe-'나' ekunene, kwaye '나' inwenwela ngaphandle kwe-'가' ezantsi. Akukho nalinye eligubungela elinye ngokupheleleyo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuba elinye ligubungela elinye ngokupheleleyo, ungathi elogqunyiweyo lincinci ngendawo. Kodwa ukuba linye linwenwela ngaphandle, kunzima ukugqiba ngokubeka elinye phezu kwelinye kuphela.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 가 likhulu. Inxalenye enwenwelayo iqhubeka ide ekunene.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ujonge kuphela ubude benxalenye enwenwelayo. Cinga nangendlela 나 enwenwela ngayo ezantsi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: 나 likhulu. Inxalenye enwenwela ezantsi ibonakala ityebile ngakumbi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Inokubonakala ngolo hlobo, kodwa awukathelekisi ubukhulu bamacandelo amabini anwenwelayo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Iindawo zomibini zifana. Amacandelo anwenwelayo abonakala efana ngokuphantse ukulingana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ukubonakala kufana asisosizathu sokuthi zifana. Zinokufana, kodwa kufuneka ujonge ngakumbi.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Awukwazi ukugqiba ngokubeka elinye phezu kwelinye kuphela. Kufuneka enye indlela nayo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uqaphele ukuba xa linye linwenwela ngaphandle emva kokubeka elinye phezu kwelinye, awunakuthi ngoko nangoko leliphi likhulu.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Kumaphepha omabini, iiseli zeekwere ezincinci zobukhulu obufanayo zazotyelwe ngaphandle kwezithuba. '가' ineengqengqelo ezi-2 zeeseli ezi-6 ngaphesheya, kwaye '나' ineengqengqelo ezi-3 zeeseli ezi-4 ngaphesheya.

z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 가 ziingqengqelo ezi-2 zeeseli ezi-6, 나 ziingqengqelo ezi-3 zeeseli ezi-4, kwaye iiseli zobukhulu obufanayo, ngoko omabini aneeseli ezili-12. Ngoko nangona imilo yahlukile, iindawo zifana. Ukuba iiseli zobukhulu obahlukileyo, awunakuthelekisa ngolu hlobo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Amaphepha omabini aneeseli ezili-12, ezifanayo, ngoko iindawo zifana.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uthelekise ngenani leeseli zonke xa iiseli zobukhulu obufanayo. Ucinge ngemo nendawo ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: 가 likhulu. Kukho iiseli ezi-6 engqengqelweni, ezingaphezu kwe-4.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ujonge ingqengqelo enye kuphela. Kufuneka ucinge nangenani leengqengqelo.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: 나 likhulu. Kukho iingqengqelo ezi-3, ezingaphezu kwezi-2.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ujonge kuphela inani leengqengqelo. Kufuneka ucinge nangenani leeseli engqengqelweni.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ukuba imilo yahlukile, awunakuthelekisa iindawo ngokubala iiseli.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukuba iiseli zobukhulu obufanayo, ungathelekisa ngenani leeseli zonke, nokuba imilo yahlukile.
z-m-03-01.s.s1.reflect: Ingcinga yakho itshintshe njani ukusuka ekujongeni kwakho ngamehlo okokuqala, ukuya ekubekeni elinye phezu kwelinye, ukuya ekuthelekiseni ngeeseli? Ukuthelekisa ngeeseli, kufuneka ntoni ifane ngeeseli?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.prompt: Umhlobo wathi, "Imilo yahlukile, ngoko iindawo zihlukile nazo!" Ungathanda ukumxelela ntoni umhlobo wakho?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.0: Jonga ukuba ingaba kukho umzekelo kumaphepha owabonileyo ngoku owenza ingxelo yomhlobo wakho ibonakale ingalunganga.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ubhale ukuba ngawaphi amanani onokuwasebenzisa njengobungqina kuloo mzekelo, uze wenze isivakalisi.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba izingcaciso zobungqina endizibhalileyo (inani leeseli, njalo njalo) ngamanani abelele kumaphepha amabini ngokwenene?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba uthethe ngokwahlukileyo ukuba 'imilo yahlukile' kunye 'neendawo zihlukile'?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uthethe nomqathango wokuba iiseli zobukhulu obufanayo?
z-m-03-01.s.s2.model.0: Omabini aneeseli ezili-12, ngoko iindawo zifana. Nokuba imilo yahlukile, iindawo zinokufana.
z-m-03-01.s.s2.model.1: Ndandingakwazi ukuxela ngokubeka elinye phezu kwelinye, kodwa xa ndibala ngeeseli zobukhulu obufanayo, zombini 가 kunye 나 ziiseli ezili-12. Ngoko iindawo zifana.

z-m-03-06.title: Ndijonge ezantsi ukusuka phezulu ndibona ezi-3, ngoko zimbalwa ezifihlakeleyo ezantsi?
z-m-03-06.topic: Iimilo ezibekwe phezu komnye (ukucinga ngeenxalenye ongazibonayo)
z-m-03-06.goal: Hlela oko ungakuthetha ngokuqinisekileyo nokungenakuthethwa ngokubona kuphela ukusuka phezulu, uze wenze iindlela ezininzi zokubeka phezu komnye ezibonakala zifana ukusuka phezulu kwaye zinenani lilonke elifanayo leebloko.
z-m-03-06.material: Iinqaba ezintathu zakhiwe macala ngeebloko zobukhulu obufanayo. Enye ikwisokhohlo, enye embindini, kwaye enye ekunene. Inqaba nganye ibekwe ukusuka emgangathweni, kwaye inqaba nganye ineengqimba ezisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwezi-3. Ejonge ezantsi ukusuka phezulu, ubona kuphela ibloko ephezulu yenqaba nganye. Awukwazi ukubona ukusuka phezulu ukuba zingaphi iingqimba zeebloko ezingezantsi.
z-m-03-06.thinking.0: Ukwahlula oko uyazi ngokuqinisekileyo kwoko ungakwaziyo koko ukubonayo

z-m-03-02.title: Intambo ixhonywe phakathi kwezikhonkwane ezimbini eludongeni: ingaba ubude bayo bufana nabo?
z-m-03-02.topic: Ukuthelekisa ubude (indlela ethe ngqo nendlela egobileyo)
z-m-03-02.goal: Fumana umgca ongalunganga kwingcamango yokuba iintambo ezimbini ezinokuqala nokuphela okufanayo kufuneka zibe nobude obufanayo, uze uthi kufuneka ntoni enye ukuze uthi ubude bufana nendlela yokujonga.
z-m-03-02.material: Kukho izikhonkwane ezimbini eludongeni. U-Jia waxhoma intambo enye engatsalwanga ngokuqinileyo phakathi kwezikhonkwane ezimbini. U-Minho waxhoma enye intambo engatsalwanga kwizikhonkwane ezifanayo ezimbini, kodwa wayixhoma ukuze ithoba ezantsi. Zombini iintambo ziqala kwisikhonkwane sasekhohlo kwaye ziphela kwisikhonkwane sasekunene. U-Jia wacinga ngolu hlobo.
